Senses.Explanation: Falls into no enumeration: the stock line the halls both cite and crack — the uncounted body against the counted colors, from Huangbo's three sentences to Zhongfeng's iron-rod warning. Huangbo Xiyun, in the discourse the anthology carries in his section, works the faith ladder down to the icchantika and then turns it: wanting the headlong awakening — erase self and things together, extinguish them together, empty them together, and get through beyond the three sentences — that is called not falling into the enumerations; the person is the faith; the teaching, the precepts, giving, hearing, wisdom; the bodhisattva patience that does not become buddha, does not become sentient being, does not hold or break the precepts — hence not holding and not breaking; Wuzu Fayan, asked by the three Buddhas — who had said the old man is just dry thatch and cannot be drawn to speak mind or nature — answers the request for instruction on the unconditioned body that falls into no enumeration with a pearl: like a pure mani jewel mirrored in the five colors — the five colors are the enumerations, the pearl is the Buddha-body; and Yuanwu Keqin told the two elders: he can really talk — when we speak it costs us so much effort, he finishes it in a line or two; plainly a great old tiger; Hongzhi Zhengjue, in the hall of his Nengren entry: good, worthies — thoughts exhausted, wisdom bright; the jade jug leads the step; the spirit empty, the gaze far; the jewel mirror holds its glow — answering the ten-thousand transformations with no lodging, not falling into the enumerations, steeped in the one true alone-shining, no dust outside — and how do you walk so as to accord with that? a long pause: the kingfisher treads and overturns the rain on the lotus leaf; the egret bursts the mist of the bamboo grove; Xutang Zhiyu opens nirvana day with the crack itself: the truth-body is unconditioned and falls into no enumeration — why then are there birth and perishing? meet it so, and I grant you see Śākyamuni himself each day as you open your mat and spread your bowl; fail, and — turning iron into gold is easy; persuading a man out of right and wrong is hard. Chushi Fanqi, in his case-raising, hands down Ehu Dayi at the capital: asked by the emperor what the way is, he turned it on the assembled doctors — walking, standing, sitting, lying, what after all is the way? — the one who knows, they said; but it cannot be known by wisdom or known by consciousness; the undiscriminating, they said; but well able to discriminate the marks of things while unmoved on the first meaning, how is that undiscriminating? the four absorptions and eight concentrations, they said; the Buddha-body is unconditioned, falls into no enumeration — how could the four absorptions and eight concentrations be it? — and the whole assembly fell mute; Dahui Zonggao: in a quarrel we let you keep your mouth; in spitting we let you splash the water; the master adds his own line: the monk lodges in the monastery; the thief robs the unguarded house; Miyun Yuanwu, asked point-blank what is the unconditioned Buddha-body that falls into no enumeration, answers with the door slammed: shut your dog's mouth; Zhongfeng Mingben, in the treatise on the great matter, turns the phrase against its riders: there are icchantika fellows who, hearing birth-and-death named, turn their heads away and drag similar-sounding lines out of the sutra books — the nature of reality pure as space, unbroken when the world breaks; the so-called unconditioned Buddha-body, not falling into the enumerations — so where would you look for the traces of birth-and-death's coming and going? asked where birth comes from, they say the flowing water was always in the sea; where death goes, the moon sets but never leaves the sky; such views are the setup for biting the iron rod and sinking into the iron ring — if you have not broken free into the true teaching, you cannot stand firm on the bank of birth-and-death; Daxiu Zhu, on his birthday, takes the question — the truth-body falls into no enumeration; can the illusory body last long? the truth-body's upward matter, please show it — and answers: take off the tattered shirt, don't put on the clean robe; then sings it through himself: up and down seized together, everywhere praised as a good hand — roaming free north, south, east, west, the gelded ox grazes off the grass at the stream's head.
